views.markdown: LSSeconds adds seconds to the clock while preserving the system lock-screen date and subtitle.

- iOS 17/18 and legacy status-bar paths
- Native lock-screen clock positioning
- Wallpaper depth-effect support
- Optional always-visible seconds and AM/PM
- AOD-aware timer behavior
- PreferenceLoader settings bundle
Seconds are intentionally paused and hidden during AOD. DoubleTapToLock compatibility is not claimed.

### 0.0.5

- Positioned the custom clock from the native clock layout to avoid date and charging overlap.
- Preserved wallpaper depth effects for the main clock.
- Added an off-by-default option to keep seconds and AM/PM above depth effects.
- Confirmed operation on iOS 17 and iOS 18.

### 0.0.4

- Added iOS 17 status-bar seconds.
- Preserved the lock-screen date and prevented duplicate clocks.
- Added a status-bar AM/PM toggle.
- Paused seconds during AOD.
- Added RootHide and rootless package layouts.
